statement: The record shows invoice 88412 from Atlas Supply was already paid in full on 3 September under reference PAY-2291, despite also listing payment status as unpaid and due, so I will place it on hold.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the record's "unpaid, due" status contradicts the payment history ("already paid in full on 3 September under reference PAY-2291"), and refuses to pay, holding it.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
